steps.name: Accept fixture data notice
steps.goal: Tap Agree and continue on the Your data and AI providers screen for this isolated demo fixture. Wait for Home. Do not tap the root element named omg.

steps.name: Open the working session
steps.goal: On Home, tap the api-gateway folder chip in the project rail. Then open the conversation titled Refactor the rate limiter to a sliding window. Do not type a message.
steps.done: The conversation screen is open and shows the newest reply and the idle follow check.
expect: The us region has finished too.

steps.name: Read back a little
steps.goal: Do not tap anything. Wait for the swipe to finish.
steps.done: The transcript has moved down to show an earlier reply, and the follow check is waiting.

steps.name: Return to the bottom
steps.goal: If a button labelled Jump to the latest is shown, tap it once. Otherwise do not tap anything.
steps.done: The newest message is visible above the composer, and the follow check is watching.
expect: The us region has finished too.

steps.name: Transcript holds still while the agent works
steps.goal: Do not tap or swipe anything. Wait until the follow check line says passed or failed.
steps.done: The follow check line has finished watching.
